thread:
maya: Morning — incoming pentest scheduled next week. Need to lock down retest window and clarify assessor access for KMS + RBAC + audit exports. Proposed retest window: Tue 2026-04-07 14:00-18:00 UTC. Can we confirm gating and evidence handoff?

samir: that window works for infra. Quick q: do we want assessors to be able to decrypt anything or only to read artifacts we pre-package? recommend pre-signed artifacts + read-only role.

alex: agree with pre-package. For KMS we should avoid giving kms:Decrypt broadly. Plan: create an "AssessorReadOnly" role with sts:AssumeRole & a scoped kms:Decrypt condition only for the assessment key alias.

luis: note: audit team needs CloudTrail export snapshots as part of evidence. We'll run 1) presigned S3 bundle for assessors, 2) separate forensic snapshot retained for 365 days for internal audits. Assessors get 90d presigned URLs.

sam: I'll own the remediation tracker and GH issue template. I'll add labels: pt/critical, pt/major, pt/minor and a "retest-needed" checklist. Will link each fix to an evidence artifact.

maya: thanks. Two blockers: 1) RBAC change window — we need an approved change ticket and on-call aware for rollback. 2) KMS key access pattern — can we publish an example IAM policy for the assessor role?

samir: here's a minimal example, we'll scope it during change ticket:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AssessorReadOnly"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/assess-key", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}}
  ]
}
```

alex: that Condition on kms is good. Also add MFA requirement for assume-role during the window? maybe require session tags so we can audit who assumed and why.

luis: on audit logs: we'll take a CloudTrail digest and S3 access logs snapshot, plus a run of k8s audit-export scoped to the namespaces in scope. Keep a tamper-proof copy in immutable storage (WORM) for 365 days.

oncall-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom.redwood/pt-bridge-3698765432 — owners: @maya @samir — please add postmortem label after retest.

maya: thanks bot. Action items: @sam create change ticket with timeframe + rollback steps; @alex prepare CloudTrail export playbook and presigned S3 script; @luis prepare KMS key policy patch and testable dry-run; @samir will own role creation and ephemeral creds automation.

sam: putting tracker PR up now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/pull/422 — includes retest checklist + evidence upload steps.

samir: one more note — during the window we'll enable read-only DB snapshots for assessors (read-only user + ip-lock). Post-retest we rotate any ephemeral keys.

maya: perfect. If nobody objects I'll file the change ticket now and loop in Product + SRE for the actual traffic-impacting windows. :thumbsup:

alex: no objections. +1 on locking down kms:Decrypt.

luis: +1. I'll prep the audit manifests and tif for WORM bucket.

maya: closing — will post the change ticket number and final schedule once created. Thanks all.
